name: cms130v6-colorectal-cancer-screening
description: CMS130v15 Colorectal Cancer Screening (2027 performance period): recommends colorectal cancer screening for adults 46-75 who have not had appropriate screening.

protocols.description: Identifies adults 46-75 with a qualifying visit who are due for colorectal cancer screening (FOBT, sDNA FIT, flexible sigmoidoscopy, CT colonography, or colonoscopy) and recommends one. Excludes colorectal cancer, total colectomy, hospice, palliative care, and the age 66+ nursing home and frailty exclusions.

meta.title: Colorectal Cancer Screening
meta.description: Adults 46-75 years of age who have not had appropriate screening for colorectal cancer.
references: U.S. Preventive Services Task Force. (2021). Screening for colorectal cancer: US Preventive Services Task Force recommendation statement. JAMA, 325(19), 1965-1977.
